Venue: Binance
Headline: Deposit Fiat or Buy Crypto/bStocks to Share $45,000 in Anthropic bStocks (ANTB) Token Vouchers!

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Fellow Binancians,
Binance is launching a limited-time promotion alongside the availability of Anthropic tokenized stocks on the Binance platform. During the Promotion Period, eligible users* who complete their first eligible deposit, crypto purchase, or bStocks purchase with fiat can unlock exclusive rewards in ANTB token vouchers.
Join Now
Promotion Period: 2026-11-19 17:30 (UTC) to 2026-12-09 23:59 (UTC)
## How To Participate
Step 1: Sign up on the landing page.
Step 2: Eligible users who complete any one of the task(s) below will each receive a $3 equivalent in ANTB token voucher.
Deposit Task: Complete a Fiat deposit of at least $100 equivalent via Card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, or SWIFT transfer or any other available payment methods on [Deposit] page; or
Buy Crypto Task: Make a crypto purchase of at least $100 equivalent via Card, Apple Pay, Google Pay or any other available payment methods on [Buy] page; or
Buy bStocks Task: Buy any bStocks of at least $100 equivalent via your fiat wallet balance, Card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay on [Buy] page.
## Notes:
*Eligible users are defined as first-time users who complete account verification from eligible jurisdictions who have not completed any fiat deposits or crypto purchases on Binance via Buy Crypto with Bank Transfer or Credit/Debit Card or Fiat Deposit prior to 2026-11-19 17:30 (UTC).
This offer is available to the first 15,000 users, on a first-come, first-served basis.
Rewards will start to be distributed from the third week after the campaign ends. Distribution timing may vary by user.
To be eligible for rewards in relation to the Deposit Task specified above, the qualifying Fiat asset deposit corresponding to the user’s highest eligible tier must be maintained for 14 days. At the end of the 14-day holding period following that deposit, the user must maintain a net Fiat asset balance equal to or greater than the amount of that deposit.

How to Deposit Fiat Currencies via SWIFT Bank Transfer and Card Payment

## Promotion Terms & Conditions
Only eligible users who complete account verification and register on the promotion page will be eligible to join this Promotion. Users are responsible for informing themselves about and observing any restrictions and/or requirements imposed with respect to the access to and use of Binance services in each country from which the services are accessed.
Participation in this Promotion is open only to users who are resident in a country or territory in which the Promotion is available, as determined by Binance in its sole and absolute discretion. The Promotion, and any rewards or benefits offered under it, may not be available to users in all jurisdictions. Binance may restrict, suspend, or exclude participation, and may withhold any reward or benefit, in respect of any user, country, or region at any time, with or without notice.
## Reward Distribution:
Users will be able to log in and redeem their ANTB token vouchers via Profile > Rewards Hub.
The ANTB token vouchers will expire within 30 days after distribution. Eligible users should claim their token vouchers before the expiration date. Learn how to redeem a voucher. If the voucher expires, no replacement will be provided.
ANTB Token Valuation: Binance uses the ANTB/USDC exchange rate as of 2026-11-19 for rewards value calculation and reward distribution. This rate is subject to change.
